classified_object.notes: ISSF-governed rifle, pistol, and shotgun competition is used as a low-locomotion embodied sport reference; no single discipline is generalized beyond common structural features.

performance_agency.summary: Athlete precision, timing, posture, and trigger execution materially determine the shot during the firing sequence.

performance_interface.summary: The body acts through a regulated firearm and shooting position; mediation is conventional equipment rather than a computational arena.

embodied_performance.summary: Embodiment is fine-motor, balance, respiratory, and sensorimotor rather than locomotor.

arena.summary: A physical range, firing line, target distance, and safety zones structure performance.

distributed_arena_relation.synchronization_mechanism: Timing, electronic targets, and result systems coordinate event state.
distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Target, equipment, and event-class controls support comparison.
distributed_arena_relation.officiation_relation: Officials and electronic scoring operate at the range.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Range command and safety authority are centralized.

sensing_tracking.summary: Electronic targets and result systems may sense impacts and timing, but computational tracking is not the athlete’s arena.

measurement.summary: Shot value and series totals are precisely measured under declared target and timing rules.

comparability.summary: Comparability is engineered through event classes, equipment control, target specifications, timing, and officiating.

officiation.summary: Officials and electronic scoring systems jointly administer results and protests.

outcome_openness.summary: Scores emerge from athlete execution under constraints.

consequence_structure.summary: Ranking, qualification, elimination, and medal outcomes follow from contest structure.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Computational systems may support measurement and officiation, but the performance arena remains physical and the spatial-athletic core is not established.

human_limits_accessibility.note: Range safety and equipment governance are central.

source_provisional_finding.summary: A strong embodied sport with little locomotion; it confirms that Embodied Performance must include fine motor, balance, and sensorimotor control without treating physical spatial skill as computational Spatiality.

content: A competition in which shared computational geometry directly constrains athlete targeting or movement as a constitutive arena.

record.provenance_note: Per-field claim_class and status preserved verbatim from the source case. source_provisional_finding is the corpus's own attributed reading, not a new Atlas verdict. Provider claims live in evidence_sources; Altis interpretation carries C4/C5.
